name: Buffer Global in Browser
rootCause: Playwright Chromium browser runtime does not have Node.js Buffer in global scope.
rule: Guard 'instanceof Buffer' with 'typeof Buffer !== "undefined" && value instanceof Buffer' and use TextEncoder fallback for Buffer.from().

name: Chained it().timeout() on Vitest
errorPattern: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined \(reading 'timeout'\)
rootCause: In Vitest, it() returns void, whereas in Mocha it returns a Test object. Calling it('...', fn).timeout(ms) throws TypeError.
rule: Pass timeout as the 3rd argument in it('name', fn, ms) and guard this.timeout inside functions with 'if (this && typeof this.timeout === "function") this.timeout(ms)'.

name: Mocha this.test.fullTitle() in Vitest Context
errorPattern: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined \(reading 'fullTitle'\)
rootCause: Vitest TestContext does not populate this.test like Mocha does.
rule: Replace this.test.fullTitle() with this?.test?.fullTitle() ?? '<fallback>'.

name: CommonJS require() in Native ESM
rootCause: Vitest browser executes in native ESM where require() is not defined.
rule: Convert 'const config = require("path/to/project.json")' to 'import config from "path/to/project.json"'.

name: Floating Promise Unhandled Rejection
rootCause: Vitest registers an unhandledRejection listener on window. Fire-and-forget promises that intentionally fail (e.g. pingServer, enqueueAndForget) bubble to window unless caught.
rule: Add .catch(() => {}) to background/fire-and-forget promise chains.

name: Prototype Augmentation Not Loaded
errorPattern: is not a function|undefined is not a function
rootCause: In Karma/Webpack, side-effect prototype extensions were eagerly evaluated. In Vitest ESM, prototype augmentations must be explicitly imported in test setup or test utilities.
rule: Explicitly import the implementation module (e.g. '../../src/api/pipeline_impl') in the test utility file.

name: Native ESM Module Mocking in Vitest 4.x with { spy: true }
errorPattern: TypeError: Cannot redefine property|TypeError: ES Modules cannot be stubbed|Cannot spy on export
rootCause: In native ESM (Vite/Vitest browser mode), imported module namespaces are sealed/frozen objects. In Vitest 4.1.10+, @vitest/mocker natively supports vi.mock('<module>', { spy: true }), which wraps every export in a mutable spy while preserving the original implementation by default.
rule: Write `vi.mock('./module', { spy: true });` at the top of the test file and use `vi.spyOn(mod, 'targetFn')` in tests. `afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())` in `test/setup.ts` automatically restores the original implementation after every test without needing `vi.hoisted(...)`, `importOriginal`, or ternary wrappers.

name: CommonJS Mocha Node Test Compatibility with Vitest
errorPattern: Error: Vitest cannot be imported in a CommonJS module using require\(\)
rootCause: When running 'yarn test:node' with ts-node in CommonJS mode, top-level 'import { vi } from "vitest"' compiles to require("vitest"), which throws because Vitest does not support CJS require().
rule: Do not import { vi } from 'vitest' in test files. Instead: 1) Add src/types/vitest-globals.d.ts with ambient global vi and Chai matcher declarations; 2) Add test/setup.mocha.ts shim providing globalThis.vi fallback and chai matchers; 3) Set 'test:node' script with 'TS_NODE_FILES=true TS_NODE_CACHE=NO' and '--require test/setup.mocha.ts'.

name: Clean Browser Global Environment (No Artificial Process Shim)
rootCause: Injecting artificial globalThis.process into the browser test runner pollutes global scope and causes packages that detect runtime environment via 'typeof process !== "undefined"' or 'process.env' to incorrectly assume they are running in Node.js.
rule: Do not inject synthetic process or process.env onto globalThis in browser test setups. Keep browser test runner global scope clean and native.

name: Lockfile Pinning over Package.json Resolutions
errorPattern: TypeError: s.stringWidth is not a function|Yarn resolutions clutter
rootCause: Adding top-level 'resolutions' blocks to monorepo package.json clutters project configuration and introduces workspace-wide overrides. In Yarn 1.x workspaces, transient dependency conflicts (e.g. CommonJS string-width on Node 22) should be resolved and pinned directly in yarn.lock.
rule: Resolve transitive dependency version constraints directly in yarn.lock to keep root package.json minimal and clean.

name: ESM Module Stubbing on Global Defaults
errorPattern: TypeError: ES Modules cannot be stubbed
rootCause: In Native ESM, imported module namespaces are sealed and immutable (Object.isFrozen === true), preventing sinon.stub from rewriting exported functions.
rule: Use global object property manipulation (or Object.defineProperty) instead of sinon.stub on imported ESM namespaces.

name: Avoid Shadowing Node.js Global Variable
rootCause: Importing a module namespace as 'global' (e.g., 'import * as global from "../src/global"') shadows the Node.js global variable 'global', causing confusion and subtle bugs.
rule: Never import a module namespace as 'global'. Use named imports like 'import { getGlobal } from "../src/global"'.

name: Avoid Stubbing process.env to Undefined in Node.js
rootCause: Stubbing process.env to undefined in Node.js is risky because Node.js internals, Vitest reporters, and async hooks depend on process.env being an object. Vitest runs tests in both Node and native Browser Chromium; browser tests naturally cover the 'typeof process === "undefined"' branch without needing synthetic stubs in Node.
rule: Do not stub process.env to undefined in Node tests. Rely on native browser test execution to verify environments where process is undefined, and delete individual environment keys if needed.

name: Resolved Error: ReferenceError: global is not defined...
rootCause: Browser environments under Playwright Chromium do not define Node.js global variable. Accessing global.__FIREBASE_DEFAULTS__ throws ReferenceError in browser.
rule: Replace global.<var> with globalThis.<var> for cross-platform browser/node global access in tests.

name: Resolved Error: TypeError: Cannot spy on export .* Modul...
errorPattern: TypeError: Cannot spy on export .* Module namespace is not configurable in ESM
rootCause: In native ESM (Vitest browser mode), imported module namespaces are sealed and unconfigurable (Object.isFrozen === true).
rule: Stub class prototype or instance methods instead of trying to stub sealed ESM module exports.

name: Resolved Error: State leakage from globalThis mutation...
rootCause: Setting globalThis properties in tests without a try...finally block leaves global state mutated if an assertion fails.
rule: Wrap test logic in try...finally to ensure globalThis cleanups always execute.

name: Resolved Error: Suite-level stubs cleaned up early by gl...
errorPattern: Suite-level stubs cleaned up early by global afterEach restore
rootCause: Calling sinon.stub in beforeAll is undone after the first test if a global afterEach calls sinon.restore().
rule: Use a dedicated sandbox (createSandbox()) for suite-level stubs and restore it in afterAll.

name: Resolved Error: Silent test pass with 0 assertions in No...
errorPattern: Silent test pass with 0 assertions in Node
rootCause: Wrapping entire test body in if (isFeatureAvailable()) causes test to pass silently with 0 assertions in unsupported environments.
rule: Use it.skipIf(!isFeatureAvailable()) so the test runner properly reports the test as skipped.

name: Preserve Const Enums in Rollup Build for ESM Consumer Compatibility
errorPattern: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '.*')|is not exported by
rootCause: TypeScript const enums are stripped at compile time unless preserveConstEnums: true is enabled in compilerOptions. When downstream packages run under Vitest/Vite in native ESM mode, the imported enum object is undefined at runtime.
rule: If a package exports a const enum used across the monorepo, ensure its rollup.config.js includes compilerOptions: { preserveConstEnums: true } in typescriptPlugin.

name: Do Not Place Ambient Test Typings in src/ Directory
rootCause: Placing vitest-globals.d.ts inside src/ causes api-extractor during yarn build to analyze it as part of the public TypeScript program, generating unwanted diffs and symbol aliasing (e.g. assert renamed to assert_2) in common/api-review/*.api.md.
rule: Never place vitest-globals.d.ts inside src/. Keep ambient test typings in test/types/ or rely on config/vitest.base.mjs globals: true.

name: ESM_BROWSER_MODULE_STUB_DELEGATOR
errorPattern: TypeError: ES Modules cannot be stubbed|Cannot spy on export
rootCause: In native browser (Playwright Chromium) and Vite ESM execution, namespace objects from import * as mod are non-configurable and sealed. sinon.stub(mod, 'prop') fails because exports are read-only getters.
rule: Hoist mock delegator with vi.hoisted(() => ({ mockTarget: { fn: (..._args: any[]) => {} } })), vi.mock(modulePath, () => delegator), and stub(mod, method) routing to sinonStub(mockTarget, method) so Sinon sandbox automatically tracks and restores it via standard sinon.restore().

name: Normalize Node-specific global to standard globalThis in tests
rootCause: In native browser (Playwright Chromium) ESM test execution, Node.js global identifier is undefined. Using global directly (e.g. sinon.stub(global, ...)) causes ReferenceError.
rule: Replace global identifier with standard ECMAScript globalThis in test files via AST codemod.

name: Migrate Mocha early return and this.skip() to Vitest conditional runners
errorPattern: TypeError: this.skip is not a function|Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'skip')
rootCause: In Vitest, arrow functions in tests lose Mocha this context, and early returns inside describe() blocks still execute hooks. this.skip() throws TypeError.
rule: Rewrite describe blocks with early returns to (condition ? describe.skip : describe) and this.skip() guards to (condition ? it : it.skip).

name: Sinon Fake Timers Background Polling Leaks
rootCause: In afterEach, calling clock.runAll() fast-forwards fake timers past polling timeout thresholds, triggering retry loops that leak unhandled promises and rogue state into subsequent tests.
rule: Do not call clock.runAll() in afterEach; use clock.restore() to safely discard pending timers. In tests with polling loops, advance only the necessary time and ensure loops conclude before test exits.

name: Migrate legacy Sinon-Chai mock assertions to native Vitest matchers
rootCause: Migrating from Sinon to Vitest mocks leaves legacy Sinon-Chai assertions (.to.have.been.calledOnce, .has.been.calledWith, .to.have.been.called, .to.not.have.been.called). While Vitest provides a compatibility layer, PR reviewers and automated bots (e.g. Gemini Code Assist) flag them as obsolete or non-idiomatic.
rule: Convert legacy Sinon-Chai assertions to native Vitest mock assertions: .calledOnce -> toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1), .calledTwice -> toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2), .calledThrice -> toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3), .called -> toHaveBeenCalled(), .not.have.been.called -> not.toHaveBeenCalled(), and .calledWith(...) -> toHaveBeenCalledWith(...).

name: Omit test:node Script in Browser-Only Packages
errorPattern: No project found with name "node"|test:node script should be removed
rootCause: Browser-only client packages (such as installations) only configure the browser test runner. Adding test:node produces a failing/obsolete npm script.
rule: Filter vitest.config.mjs projects to browser only and do not scaffold test:node in package.json for browser-only packages.

name: Migrate Legacy Chai Assertions to Native Vitest Matchers
rootCause: Leaving legacy Chai assertions (.to.equal, .to.deep.equal, .to.throw) clutters code, risks runtime errors when Chai is uninstalled, and triggers bot/reviewer warnings.
rule: Convert all Chai assertions to native Vitest matchers: .to.equal -> .toBe, .to.deep.equal -> .toEqual, .to.throw -> .toThrow, .to.be.undefined -> .toBeUndefined, .to.be.null -> .toBeNull.

name: sinon_stub_methods_to_vitest_mock
rootCause: Sinon stubs use resolves/returns/callsFake/rejects while Vitest MockInstance uses mockResolvedValue/mockReturnValue/mockImplementation/mockRejectedValue.
rule: Transform Sinon stub methods to Vitest mock methods and convert calledOnce assertions to toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1).

name: ESM Export Mocking via vi.hoisted and vi.mock
rootCause: In Vitest browser mode running native ESM, imported module namespaces are sealed. vi.spyOn() on namespace exports fails with Cannot spy on export. vi.mock with vi.hoisted must be used. When passthrough is needed, unmocked functions can be captured and preserved.
rule: undefined

name: Stub Console and Native Methods with mockImplementation
errorPattern: console noise in test log|vi.spyOn.*without mockImplementation|calls through to original method
rootCause: In Vitest, vi.spyOn() calls through to the original implementation by default. When spying on console/logger methods or native browser/node methods where code should not run, this causes unwanted test log noise (e.g., console.warn/error output) and unnecessary computation. Chaining .mockImplementation(() => {}) or .mockReturnValue(...) is required to stub out the method.
rule: When spying on console, logger, or native browser/Node methods where the real implementation should not run (e.g. to silence test log noise or save unnecessary computation), chain .mockImplementation(() => {}) or .mockReturnValue(...) to turn the spy into a stub: vi.spyOn(console, 'info').mockImplementation(() => {}). Avoid bare vi.spyOn() for these methods as it calls through by default.

name: Firebase App Deleted Heartbeat IndexedDB Race
errorPattern: Firebase: Firebase App named '.*' already deleted \(app/app-deleted\)|app-deleted
rootCause: When tests call initializeApp() and deleteApp(app), the default HeartbeatService initialized with the app asynchronously reads/writes to IndexedDB via HeartbeatStorageImpl. If deleteApp(app) finishes and marks app.isDeleted = true while the heartbeat storage promise is still executing, computeKey(app) accesses app.name or app.options, which throws AppError.APP_DELETED and logs a warning via @firebase/app logger.
rule: In test suites that call initializeApp() and deleteApp(app), overwrite the 'heartbeat' component with a dummy component using _addOrOverwriteComponent(app, new Component('heartbeat', () => ({ triggerHeartbeat: () => {}, getHeartbeatsHeader: () => Promise.resolve('') } as any), ComponentType.PUBLIC)) in beforeEach to prevent background IndexedDB operations from executing against a deleted app.

name: Prevent Importing Test Suite Files for Helper Functions
rootCause: Importing helper functions (createApp, createStorage) directly from a test file (e.g. integration.test.ts) causes Vitest to execute the entire imported test suite as side-effects inside other test files.
rule: Extract shared test helpers (createApp, createStorage, mock tokens) into dedicated testshared.ts files rather than exporting them from files containing describe() blocks.
commentTemplate: // Extract shared test helpers into a separate testshared.ts to avoid running test suites on import

name: Concise Single-Line Comment for vi.hoisted Module Spy Layers
errorPattern: vi\.hoisted.*vi\.mock|redundant at first glance|spy layer on methods
rootCause: Wrapping ESM module exports in vi.hoisted and forwarding them in vi.mock can appear redundant to reviewers without context. A concise explanation avoids confusion while keeping test files clean.
rule: When creating a spy layer on module exports using vi.hoisted and vi.mock, add a standardized single-line comment: // This inserts <mockName> as a spy layer on methods coming from ./<module>. Do not write lengthy multi-line explanations.
commentTemplate: // This inserts mockGenerateContent as a spy layer on methods coming from ./generate-content.ts

name: Assert Error Message Instead of Mutating Error Name
rootCause: In legacy Sinon tests, custom error names were sometimes set (e.g. customErr.name = 'foo') to assert error identity. In Vitest, standard Error instances should be used and .message asserted, avoiding extra lines of custom error mutation.
rule: When mocking rejected promises or asserting caught errors, use standard new Error('msg') and assert expect((e as Error).message).toBe('msg') or expect(promise).rejects.toThrow('msg'). Do not assign custom .name to generic Error objects.

name: No Node 20 Polyfills or Fallbacks in Test Suites
errorPattern: typeof.*WebSocket === 'undefined'|typeof WebSocket === 'undefined'|safe to not accommodate Node 20
rootCause: CI runs on Node 22 and upcoming major SDK releases require Node 24. Adding Node 20 compatibility shims (e.g., checking if global WebSocket is undefined and providing dummy classes) clutters tests and requires manual cleanup in afterEach.
rule: Do not add synthetic fallbacks or polyfills for Node 20 in test suites. Rely on native Node >= 22 capabilities (like global WebSocket). Tests should target Node 22+ directly.

name: Keep Test Titles Consistent with Error Assertions
rootCause: When migrating Chai/Sinon error assertions to Vitest .rejects.toThrow(reason), leaving references to specific error types like DOMException in test titles is misleading if the assertion only verifies the error message/reason.
rule: Update test titles to remove specific error class names (e.g., change 'should throw DOMException if...' to 'should throw if...') when the test only asserts the thrown error message or abort reason.

name: Mandatory Changeset for Any Production Code or Typings Changes
errorPattern: need to make a changeset to mark the code change|changes the production bundle
rootCause: Any modifications to files under src/ (including type re-exports like 'export type { ... }' or bundle adjustments) affect the generated production bundle or public typings. A changeset is required for version tracking and release changelogs.
rule: If a migration PR makes ANY changes to files under src/ (even type-only re-exports or bundle adjustments), ALWAYS create a patch changeset in .changeset/<package>-vitest-migration.md.

name: ESM Module Spying with vi.mock('<module>', { spy: true }) and vi.restoreAllMocks()
errorPattern: Cannot spy on export|Cannot redefine property|Module namespace is not configurable in ESM|getMockImplementation
rootCause: In Vitest Browser Mode and Native ESM, module namespace exports are read-only, non-configurable bindings (`writable: false, configurable: false`). Calling `vi.spyOn(ns, 'fn')` without `vi.mock` throws `TypeError: Cannot spy on export`. Because this repo runs Vitest 4.1.10 (`@vitest/mocker`), `vi.mock('<module>', { spy: true })` natively wraps every export in a mutable spy while keeping the original implementation by default.
rule: Declare `vi.mock('./module', { spy: true });` at the module top level and use `vi.spyOn(moduleNamespace, 'exportName')` in `beforeEach` or `it()` blocks. `afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())` in `test/setup.ts` automatically restores the original implementation after every test without needing `vi.hoisted(...)`, `importOriginal`, or ternary wrappers.

name: Firestore Vitest Browser Isolation, Mixed Type Re-Exports, and Scoped Equality Matchers
rootCause: 1) Vitest browser mode runs each test file in an iframe with fileParallelism: true by default, causing shared IndexedDB databases (SimpleDb.delete) to block across concurrent iframes and running setupFiles 118 times. 2) Native Chromium ESM rejects type-only re-exports inside mixed value/type export statements (e.g., LogLevelString, EmulatorMockTokenOptions). 3) Calling expect.addEqualityTesters multiple times with isActive=true at describe-evaluation time causes later suites with empty matchers to shadow earlier suites. 4) Mocha's this.test!.fullTitle() throws synchronously in Vitest before .finally(() => simpleDb.close()) can run, leaving IndexedDB connections open.
rule: 1) Configure browser project with `fileParallelism: false, isolate: false` in `vitest.config.mjs`. 2) Add a pre-enforce `stripTypeExportsPlugin` using `ts.createProgram` emit for `.ts` files with `export {` on the browser project. 3) Scope `expect.addEqualityTesters` in `test/util/equality_matcher.ts` via a single registered tester backed by an `activeMatcherSets` stack pushed in `beforeAll` and popped in `afterAll`, and delegate objects with `asymmetricMatch`. 4) Replace `this.test!.fullTitle()` with `(expect.getState().currentTestName ?? 'test')` and wrap `withCustomPersistence` in `try / finally { await persistence.shutdown(); }`.

name: tsconfig-vitest-globals-and-exclude-config
errorPattern: TS5055: Cannot write file '.*vitest\.base\.mjs' because it would overwrite input file|TS2304: Cannot find name 'expect'
rootCause: Vitest runs via esbuild without tsc or eslint. When Rollup/tsc builds a package whose tsconfig.json includes test files or omits vitest.config.mjs from exclude, tsc fails with TS2304 (missing Vitest globals) and TS5055 (allowJs traversing ../../config/vitest.base.mjs).
rule: In packages whose tsconfig.json compiles test files or does not specify "include": ["src"], add "../../node_modules/vitest/globals" to compilerOptions.types and add "vitest.config.mjs" to exclude so rollup-plugin-typescript2 (allowJs: true) does not traverse ../../config/vitest.base.mjs. Always run yarn build and yarn lint locally before committing.

name: eslint-no-restricted-properties-skipIf
rootCause: firebase-js-sdk's root .eslintrc.js bans describe.skip and it.skip via no-restricted-properties to prevent accidentally committed skipped tests, whereas Vitest's native describe.skipIf(cond) and it.skipIf(cond) are allowed.
rule: Use describe.skipIf(condition) and it.skipIf(condition) instead of (condition ? describe.skip : describe) or (condition ? it.skip : it) ternaries. For custom Mocha wrappers (like asyncIt), augment Mocha.TestFunction with skipIf(condition: boolean).

name: indexeddb-fake-timers-aftereach-ordering
rootCause: In Vitest, afterEach hooks run in LIFO (stack) order, and vi.runAllTimersAsync() only drains timers/microtasks, not browser IndexedDB transactions. Running vi.runAllTimersAsync() or vi.useRealTimers() before awaiting IndexedDB clear() allows dangling background promises (such as registerInstallation / waitUntilFidRegistration) to write to IndexedDB or schedule real timers after clear(), polluting IndexedDB for the next test.
rule: In afterEach hooks that clean up both IndexedDB and fake timers, always await IndexedDB clear() BEFORE calling vi.clearAllTimers() and vi.useRealTimers(), and do not call vi.runAllTimersAsync() before clear() when background promises perform IndexedDB writes after timer resolution. Also disable browser.screenshotFailures in vitest.config.mjs so failure screenshots are never created or committed.

name: preserve-require-project-json-for-tsc-rootdir
errorPattern: The "mainEntryPointFilePath" path does not exist: .*dist/firestore/src/index\.d\.ts|TS2307: Cannot find module '\.\./\.\./\.\./\.\./\.\./config/project\.json'
rootCause: Replacing require('../../../../../config/project.json') with ES import causes tsc to fail with TS2307 when config/project.json is absent, and when config/project.json is present, tsc includes config/project.json (at the repo root) in the program, shifting TypeScript's inferred rootDir from packages/ to the repo root and emitting declarations to dist/packages/<pkg>/src/index.d.ts instead of dist/<pkg>/src/index.d.ts.
rule: Never replace CommonJS require('../../../../../config/project.json') with static ES import in TypeScript files compiled by tsconfig.json. Instead, keep require('../../../../../config/project.json') in the .ts file and transform it in vitest.config.mjs via a Vite pre-transform plugin.

name: Targeted onUnhandledError Instead of dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors
rootCause: Karma/Mocha ignored background unhandled promise rejections after test completion, whereas Vitest fails the run by default. Using `dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors: true` globally masks genuine bugs across all tests.
rule: Never set `dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors: true` in `vitest.config.mjs`. First, await or `.catch(() => {})` intentional error promises directly in the test. If a background rejection occurs inside SDK initialization before a handler is attached during a negative test, define a targeted `config.test.onUnhandledError = error => { if (error?.message?.includes('<exact expected message>')) return false; }` at the top level of `vitest.config.mjs` so only that specific error is ignored and all other unhandled errors still fail the run.

name: Vitest .skip Property Getter Breaks Chained Custom Modifiers
rootCause: In Mocha, `it.skip` and `describe.skip` are static function objects that can be mutated once at import time. In Vitest, `.skip` is a property getter that returns a fresh function instance on every access, losing any custom properties attached earlier.
rule: Wrap `.skip` accesses in a `getSkip(base)` helper that re-attaches custom chainable properties (`Object.assign(skipFn, { skipEnterprise: ..., skipEmulator: ... })`) to the newly returned function instance whenever `.skip` is evaluated.

name: Empty or Conditionally Skipped Test Suites in Vitest
errorPattern: No test suite found in file
rootCause: Mocha allowed test files with only a top-level `before()` hook and zero `it()` blocks, or `describe(...)` callbacks that returned early when disabled by an env flag. Vitest fails any `.test.ts` file that registers zero active or skipped tests.
rule: Wrap standalone `beforeAll` setup files in `describe('...', () => { beforeAll(...); it('...', () => {}); })`. For suites conditionally disabled by environment variables, apply `.skip` at the suite definition (`(enabled ? describe : describe.skip)('...', () => { ... })`) rather than returning early inside the `describe` callback.

name: Use toBeCloseTo Instead of Math.abs().toBeLessThanOrEqual()
rootCause: Converting floating-point approximations to `expect(Math.abs(a - b)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(...)` produces uninformative failure diffs and triggers code review bot suggestions.
rule: Convert Chai `.to.be.closeTo(expected, delta)` / `.to.be.approximately(expected, delta)` to native Vitest `expect(actual).toBeCloseTo(expected, precisionDigits)` (e.g. `1e-7` -> `7`, `0.001` -> `3`, `0.1` -> `1`) instead of `expect(Math.abs(actual - expected)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(delta)`.
